definitions.explanation: A high level of skill achieved through extensive practice and training. Implies refined expertise developed over time.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{練達|れんたつ}した{通訳者|つうやくしゃ}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: She is known as an accomplished interpreter.

examples.japanese: {練達|れんたつ}の{医師|いし}でなければ、この{手術|しゅじゅつ}は{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Unless you're an expert physician, this surgery is difficult.

notes:
USAGE: {練達|れんたつ} emphasizes skill acquired through rigorous training and practice. Often used with の to modify nouns ({練達|れんたつ}の{職人|しょくにん}).

FORMALITY: Formal/literary. More common in written language than casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練達|れんたつ}の{士|し}/{者|しゃ} (master, expert)
- {練達|れんたつ}した{技術|ぎじゅつ}/{腕前|うでまえ} (mastered skill)
- {練達|れんたつ}を{極|きわ}める (to attain mastery)

RELATED WORDS:
- {熟練|じゅくれん} (skilled - more commonly used)
- {熟達|じゅくたつ} (proficiency - similar meaning)
- {達人|たつじん} (master, expert - noun form)
